locations.note: Peter and Miles share a New York that now takes in Brooklyn and Queens as Kraven's Hunters come hunting and the symbiote takes hold.
Peter starts teaching physics at Brooklyn Visions Academy, with Miles in his class, until Sandman's rampage cuts the day short.
Peter and Miles chase the rampaging Sandman through the Financial District in the game's opening fight.
Peter lives in Aunt May's old house in Queens, where Harry Osborn turns up seemingly cured and offers him a job.
Kraven's Hunters attack the park to capture Tombstone; a newly super-powered Harry helps Peter save the crowd and learns he is Spider-Man.
The symbiote-possessed Harry escapes into Times Square, beats Kraven's Hunters and kills Kraven himself, then sets out as Venom to infect the city.

routes.name: Peter and Miles
routes.note: From Peter's first day at Brooklyn Visions Academy and the fight with Sandman in the Financial District to the Hunters' attack on Coney Island and Venom's rise in Times Square.
